newsitem.title: FRANCE: Merrill Lynch cuts Pinault, LVMH recommendations.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch cuts Pinault, LVMH recommendations.

text.p: Merrill Lynch has cut its recommendation on shares of Pinault-Printemps-La Redoute and LVMH, the London-based office of the U.S. bank said on Friday.
Merrill Lynch changed to "neutral" from "accumulate" its short-term recommendation on Pinault-Printemps, following a strong stock performance.

It changed to "sell" from "neutral" its short-term advice on LVMH due to disappointing first half results and concern over lower margins. But it maintained its "accumulate" recommendation on the stock for the long term.
Pinault-Printemps lost 1.1 percent to 1,880 francs at 1425 GMT.
LVMH gained 3.97 percent to 1,100 francs after falling 3.9 percent on Thursday.
